name: s03-fuel-nozzle
prompt: Refuelling a truck from a fuel pump nozzle: the nozzle clunks into the filler neck, then liquid fuel glugs and flows into a metal tank for a few seconds, ending with the nozzle clicking off and being pulled out. Close, outdoors, dry. Length: 6 seconds

name: s04-jump-start-kit
prompt: Jump-starting a truck: two heavy metal battery clamps clipped onto battery terminals with sharp spring snaps, a small spark crackle, then a starter motor cranking briefly. Close, outdoors. Length: 4 seconds

name: s05-booster-pack
prompt: A portable jump starter booster pack: plastic clamps snapped onto a battery, a soft electronic relay click and one short quiet beep, then a starter motor cranking briefly. Close perspective. Length: 4 seconds

name: s06-warning-chime
prompt: A single soft dashboard warning chime from a vehicle instrument panel, one gentle two-tone electronic bong with a short decay, calm and quiet, not alarming. Length: 1 second

name: s07-tyre-burst
prompt: A large truck tyre bursting with a sharp pop and a rush of escaping air, then the flat tyre flapping and thumping against the road as the truck slows. Outdoors, mid distance. Length: 4 seconds

name: s08-coolant-boiling
prompt: Steam hissing continuously from an overheated engine radiator under a truck bonnet, a steady pressurised hiss with occasional gurgles of boiling coolant, continuous and unchanging. Length: 8 seconds

name: s09-flat-battery
prompt: Trying to start a truck with a flat battery: the key turned three times, each turn giving only a rapid dry clicking of the starter solenoid and no cranking. Close, inside the cab. Length: 4 seconds

name: s10-failed-start-diesel
prompt: A cold diesel truck engine failing to start: the starter motor cranks slowly and laboriously, the engine coughs once but does not catch, and the cranking stops. Outdoors, close. Length: 5 seconds

name: s10-failed-start-petrol
prompt: A petrol car engine failing to start: the starter motor cranks with a weak, slowing whirr, the engine sputters but never catches, then silence. Outdoors, close. Length: 5 seconds

name: s11-knock-diesel
prompt: A worn diesel engine idling with a heavy rhythmic metallic knocking from the bottom end, a steady deep mechanical clatter, rough, continuous and unchanging. Length: 8 seconds

name: s11-knock-petrol
prompt: A worn petrol engine idling with a light rapid tapping and knocking from loose valves, steady rough running, continuous and unchanging. Length: 8 seconds

name: s12-brake-squeal
prompt: Worn truck brakes squealing as a heavy vehicle slows to a stop, a short metallic grinding squeal that fades as it stops. Outdoors, mid distance. Length: 3 seconds

name: s13-air-compressor
prompt: A truck's air brake compressor charging after stopping: a steady mechanical chugging pump for a few seconds, then the air dryer purging with one short sharp hiss. Outdoors, beside the truck. Length: 6 seconds

name: s14-oxygen-regulator
prompt: Medical oxygen flowing steadily from a cylinder regulator through a face mask, a soft gentle hiss of gas, quiet and calm, close, continuous and unchanging. Length: 8 seconds

name: s15-safety-valve
prompt: A steam locomotive boiler safety valve lifting and blowing off: a powerful roaring rush of steam venting into the open air for a few seconds, then reseating. Outdoors, mid distance. Length: 5 seconds

name: s16-battery-venting
prompt: A large lithium battery pack failing: a sharp pop, then a fierce pressurised hiss of gas venting from the cells with crackling, growing stronger. Outdoors. Length: 5 seconds

name: s17-cargo-set-down
prompt: A heavy wooden crate set down onto the metal floor of a truck's cargo bed, one solid muffled thud with a short hollow metal resonance. Close. Length: 1 second

name: s17-cargo-taken-off
prompt: A heavy wooden crate slid and lifted off the metal floor of a truck's cargo bed, one short scrape and a soft knock. Close. Length: 1 second
